scenePurpose: 把女主从熟悉的石桥空间带入不可抵达的神圣尺度，情绪由好奇转为敬畏。

shots.purpose: 建立女主、石桥、云海和高处未知空间的关系。
shots.cameraAngle: eye-level with a slightly elevated horizon
shots.cameraHeight: slightly below the woman's eye line

movement.speedCurve: no camera movement; only environmental motion
movement.peakState: she stops as a distant light appears through cloud
movement.endState: her eyeline points into the upper-right negative space

shots.composition: stone bridge leads from lower left to upper right; woman is the only human figure; empty cloud space withholds the palace
shots.actionBeat: she crosses two steps, stops and notices something beyond the cloud
shots.performance: movement ceases before the face changes; attention shifts through posture and eyeline
shots.lighting: cool overcast environment light with a faint warm source hidden behind the cloud
shots.soundEdit: footsteps stop; wind remains; a distant low bell enters before the cut

continuity.screenDirection: woman moves left to right and keeps looking upper-right
continuity.axis: camera remains on the near side of the bridge axis

shots.framePrompt: 电影感写实宽景：云上石桥、月白朱绫女子从左下进入后停步，云海遮住上方未知目标；35mm、克制的冷环境光、真实石材和丝绸、自然人体比例、保留上方负空间，不出现完整天宫。

shots.purpose: 把观众的注意力从女主的动作转移到她正在看见的光和空间变化。

lens.character: restrained perspective and intimate reaction space

movement.direction: slow forward along the existing eyeline
movement.speedCurve: gentle start, almost imperceptible acceleration, settle before the reveal
movement.startState: back and shoulder fill the lower foreground
movement.peakState: a warm rim separates the silhouette from the cloud
movement.endState: the eyeline remains open for the following wide reveal

shots.composition: woman's shoulder anchors the lower-left foreground; cloud opening occupies the upper-right; no face reveal yet
shots.actionBeat: she raises her chin by a small amount and holds
shots.performance: wonder is carried by stillness, breath and a slight release in the shoulders
shots.lighting: warm rim light grazes hair and silk edge while the face remains mostly in cool reflected light
shots.soundEdit: breath becomes audible; the bell moves closer without becoming a musical climax

continuity.axis: same side of the bridge axis as shot 01

shots.framePrompt: 电影感写实过肩中近景：月白朱绫女子的肩背和发丝位于左下，暖色逆光刚刚勾出轮廓，右上云层出现一条明亮缝隙；50mm、自然呼吸和丝绸重量、表情不夸张、目标仍未完整出现。

shots.purpose: 完成延迟揭示，让远方天宫成为压倒性的空间和叙事事实。

lens.character: foreground parallax and monumental spatial expansion

movement.direction: slowly right through the foreground column
movement.speedCurve: near-static start, gentle reveal acceleration, ease-out into a long hold
movement.startState: column blocks most of the palace and woman is small below
movement.peakState: column clears and the palace opens above the cloud sea
movement.endState: woman and palace share a stable diagonal and the frame holds

shots.composition: column exits left; woman remains lower-third scale anchor; palace occupies upper distance; layered cloud bands preserve depth
shots.actionBeat: the palace becomes visible at the exact moment the woman's gaze settles
shots.performance: she does not step forward; the world grows around her through the reveal
shots.lighting: cool cloud light, warm low-angle rim behind palace, coherent shadows and restrained haze
shots.soundEdit: bell resolves, wind opens, then a quiet hold leaves space for the audience reaction

continuity.eyeline: woman's gaze lands on palace upper-center
continuity.axis: same bridge axis; movement reveals rather than crosses it

shots.framePrompt: 电影感写实史诗宽景：前景巨柱从左侧退出，露出云海上方遥远天宫；月白朱绫女子保持很小比例站在下方石桥，24mm、略低于眼平、冷环境光与有动机的暖色逆光、真实石材丝绸云雾、分层空气透视、敬畏而非恐惧、稳定终帧。
